text: The team identified unresolved functions to include, indicating that scope is still unclear.
A simpler remote solution is needed to accommodate elderly users who may struggle with the current setup.
The User Interface Designer will group the menu into a display group and a basic functions group and create maps of the data gathered.

Teletext functionality will be skipped; the target age range is sixteen to forty; two groups of functions will be provided (simple for the public and advanced for younger users), with extra advanced options on the onscreen display and the screen placed on the top.
